name: alea-legal-benchmark-contract-metadata
description: A dataset for extracting and classifying metadata from legal contracts (e.g., contract type, jurisdiction, parties, effective dates). It measures models' ability to predict structured metadata labels from contract text, supporting multi-label and multi-class classification tasks. The benchmark is intended to evaluate information extraction and contract understanding in the legal domain.
reputation: A niche, domain-specific benchmark from the Alea Institute with limited but growing use among legal-NLP researchers.
